summary: Frontend-only e2e test of the new ChatGPT AI integration (4 capabilities) as CEO on tenant nyla-air-water. All 5 requested tests PASSED with real streamed LLM output. Total LLM calls made: 3 (chat Q1, chat Q2, dashboard insights, lead WhatsApp draft = 4 total — within budget). Account dialog test 4 opened only, no generate.

integration_issues.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText fails inside headless test browser (clipboard permission not granted) → 'Copy failed' toast appears. This is a TEST-ENV limitation only, not a product bug. Real users in normal browsers with page focus have clipboard permission and copy works. No fix needed.

test_results.TEST_1_AIAssistant_chat: PASS — Launcher (ai-assistant-launcher) visible bottom-right, panel opens on click showing ai-empty-state + 3 suggestion chips (ai-suggestion-0/1/2). Sent 'How many distributors do we have? One line.' → streamed answer: 'We have 17 distributors total.' (mentions 17 ✅). Multi-turn follow-up 'and accounts?' → 'We have 13 accounts total.' (mentions 13 ✅ — context preserved). Closed and reopened panel → ai-session-select History dropdown appeared with 3 prior sessions. Clicked first session → 4 messages loaded (persistence ✅).
test_results.TEST_2_Dashboard_Insights: PASS — Navigated to /dashboard, ai-insights-card visible at bottom. Clicked ai-insights-generate ONCE → streamed 1558-char markdown into ai-insights-output. All 5 sections present: Highlights, Sales & Deliveries, Inventory, Pipeline, Risks & Recommendations. Correct real data (MTD 2 deliveries / 2 units vs last month 16/184, 36 new leads / 17 won).
test_results.TEST_3_Lead_AI_Assist: PASS — Opened first lead detail (Drive Folder Test Lead). Header ai-assist-button visible, dialog opened (ai-draft-dialog). ai-draft-type defaulted to 'Summary & next actions'. Changed to 'Draft WhatsApp message', typed 'under 30 words' in ai-draft-instructions, clicked ai-draft-generate ONCE. Streamed draft in ai-draft-output: 'Hi! Your lead with Drive Folder Test Lead is now marked Won 🎉 Thanks for the update — looking forward to the next steps.' (120 chars, well under 30 words). ai-draft-copy button present and clickable (see note in integration_issues re: clipboard in headless env).
test_results.TEST_4_Account_AI_Assist_open_only: PASS — /accounts list → clicked first account-row-DRIV-HYD-A26-001 → navigated to /accounts/DRIV-HYD-A26-001. Header ai-assist-button visible when not editing, dialog opened. DialogDescription shows 'Account · Drive Folder Test Lead' (account name present ✅). Type dropdown shows all 4 expected options for account context: ['Summary & next actions', 'Draft email', 'Draft WhatsApp message', 'Draft proposal text'] — issue_response correctly filtered out. Closed without generating (saved credits as instructed).
test_results.TEST_5_Console_and_overlap: PASS — Only pre-existing 401s on /api/auth/me during token-refresh before X-Tenant-ID is set (documented in prior iterations). No NEW console errors from AI flows. The dev-mode 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' overlay is a well-known benign React dev-server warning (bundle.js:117530 handleError) unrelated to AI code — appears in prod-mode without overlay. Launcher (bottom-right ~x=1520,y=840) does NOT overlap the 'Ask Nyla' right-edge tab (mid-right ~y=430) — clear vertical separation.

critical_code_review_comments: AIAssistant.jsx: streaming/loading UX is clean — user bubble + assistant bubble with spinner then streamed markdown works well. Multi-turn context via session_id is correctly wired.
AIDraftDialog.jsx: DRAFT_TYPES filter by contextType (line 48) elegantly hides 'issue_response' from account/lead dialogs — 4 options exactly as expected.
AIInsightsCard.jsx: single generate button with correct Regenerate label swap once output present. Streamed markdown renders all 5 sections.
aiStream.js not directly reviewed here but SSE streaming works reliably — all 3 endpoints (/api/ai/chat, /api/ai/draft, /api/ai/insights) streamed within 2-15s to first token.

Minor UX suggestion (non-blocking): 'Copy failed' toast in headless envs is confusing. Consider wrapping navigator.clipboard.writeText in a permission check with a fallback to a hidden textarea + document.execCommand('copy'). Not needed for real users.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing tenant data (17 distributors, 13 accounts, existing leads).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 AI capabilities (global assistant chat, dashboard insights, lead AI assist, account AI assist) are wired correctly and stream real LLM output via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. AIAssistant is mounted in DashboardLayout so launcher appears globally. AIInsightsCard mounts at bottom of /dashboard (Dashboard.js line 407). Lead detail: LeadDetail.js line 2567; Account detail: AccountDetail.js line 3925. Sessions persist per user — after chatting they show in ai-session-select dropdown. Each Generate/Send is a REAL LLM call; keep test messages short. The 'Copy failed' toast in Playwright tests is a headless-browser clipboard permission quirk, not a bug. Consider granting context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']) in future test scripts if verifying copy.
